papers.title: Improved prediction accuracy for disease risk mapping using Gaussian Process stacked generalisation
papers.abstract: Maps of infectious disease---charting spatial variations in the force of infection, degree of endemicity, and the burden on human health---provide an essential evidence base to support planning towards global health targets. Contemporary disease mapping efforts have embraced statistical modelling approaches to properly acknowledge uncertainties in both the available measurements and their spatial interpolation. The most common such approach is that of Gaussian process regression, a mathematical framework comprised of two components: a mean function harnessing the predictive power of multiple independent variables, and a covariance function yielding spatio-temporal shrinkage against residual variation from the mean. Though many techniques have been developed to improve the flexibility and fitting of the covariance function, models for the mean function have typically been restricted to simple linear terms. For infectious diseases, known to be driven by complex interactions between environmental and socio-economic factors, improved modelling of the mean function can greatly boost predictive power. Here we present an ensemble approach based on stacked generalisation that allows for multiple, non-linear algorithmic mean functions to be jointly embedded within the Gaussian process framework. We apply this method to mapping Plasmodium falciparum prevalence data in Sub-Saharan Africa and show that the generalised ensemble approach markedly out-performs any individual method.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要针对传染病风险映射，而非生物力学或植入物设计的代理建模，但高斯过程堆叠方法可能对不确定性量化有间接参考价值。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, structural mechanics, or implant design, and its application is purely epidemiological with no biomedical engineering context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高传染病风险映射的预测精度
summary_zh.method: 提出基于堆叠泛化的高斯过程集成方法，允许非线性算法均值函数嵌入
summary_zh.result: 在恶性疟原虫流行数据上显著优于单一方法
summary_zh.validation: 使用非洲撒哈拉以南地区疟疾流行数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve prediction accuracy in infectious disease risk mapping by enhancing the mean function of Gaussian process regression.
summary_en.method: An ensemble approach based on stacked generalization integrates multiple non-linear algorithmic mean functions into the Gaussian process framework.
summary_en.result: The proposed method substantially outperforms individual methods when applied to mapping Plasmodium falciparum prevalence in Sub-Saharan Africa.
summary_en.validation: Validated on real-world malaria prevalence data from Sub-Saharan Africa.

papers.title: Parameter Estimation of a Nonlinear Burgers Model using Nanoindentation and Finite Element-based Inverse Analysis
papers.abstract: Nanoindentation involves probing a hard diamond tip into a material, where the load and the displacement experienced by the tip is recorded continuously. This load-displacement data is a direct function of material's innate stress-strain behavior. Thus, theoretically it is possible to extract mechanical properties of a material through nanoindentation. However, due to various nonlinearities associated with nanoindentation the process of interpreting load-displacement data into material properties is difficult. Although, simple elastic behavior can be characterized easily, a method to characterize complicated material behavior such as nonlinear viscoelasticity is still lacking. In this study, a nanoindentation-based material characterization technique is developed to characterize soft materials exhibiting nonlinear viscoelasticity. Nanoindentation experiment was modeled in finite element analysis software (ABAQUS), where a nonlinear viscoelastic behavior was incorporated using user-defined subroutine (UMAT). The model parameters were calibrated using a process called inverse analysis. In this study, a surrogate model-based approach was used for the inverse analysis. The different factors affecting the surrogate model performance are analyzed in order to optimize the performance with respect to the computational cost.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法利用替代模型加速纳米压痕的有限元逆分析，可迁移至生物力学中材料参数辨识问题。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address multi-constraint optimization, uncertainty quantification, or implant-specific biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 从纳米压痕数据中提取软材料的非线性粘弹性参数。
summary_zh.method: 用ABAQUS建立纳米压痕有限元模型，结合UMAT子程序，通过替代模型进行逆分析。
summary_zh.result: 分析了影响替代模型性能的因素，以优化计算成本。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元模拟验证替代模型的参数辨识精度。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize nonlinear viscoelastic behavior of soft materials from nanoindentation load-displacement data.
summary_en.method: A finite element model of nanoindentation with a user-defined material subroutine (UMAT) is combined with a surrogate model-based inverse analysis.
summary_en.result: Factors affecting surrogate model performance are analyzed to optimize the trade-off between accuracy and computational cost.
summary_en.validation: The inverse method is validated on synthetic nanoindentation data generated by the finite element model.

papers.title: Active Learning for Speech Recognition: the Power of Gradients
papers.abstract: In training speech recognition systems, labeling audio clips can be expensive, and not all data is equally valuable. Active learning aims to label only the most informative samples to reduce cost. For speech recognition, confidence scores and other likelihood-based active learning methods have been shown to be effective. Gradient-based active learning methods, however, are still not well-understood. This work investigates the Expected Gradient Length (EGL) approach in active learning for end-to-end speech recognition. We justify EGL from a variance reduction perspective, and observe that EGL's measure of informativeness picks novel samples uncorrelated with confidence scores. Experimentally, we show that EGL can reduce word errors by 11\%, or alternatively, reduce the number of samples to label by 50\%, when compared to random sampling.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与有限元替代模型或生物力学设计方向完全无关，无法迁移。
llm.why_not_core: This paper applies active learning to speech recognition, with no FEA, surrogate modeling, constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 语音识别中标注成本高，需高效选择样本。
summary_zh.method: 使用期望梯度长度（EGL）进行主动学习。
summary_zh.result: 相比随机采样，EGL降低词错误率11%或减少50%标注量。
summary_zh.validation: 在语音识别数据集上实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce labeling cost in speech recognition by selecting the most informative audio clips.
summary_en.method: Investigated the Expected Gradient Length (EGL) approach for active learning in end-to-end speech recognition.
summary_en.result: EGL reduced word error rate by 11% or halved the number of labeled samples compared to random sampling.
summary_en.validation: Experimental evaluation on speech recognition datasets.

papers.title: Blood loss and transfusion rate in short stem hip arthroplasty. A comparative study
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Little scientific evidence on blood loss and transfusion rates after short-stem hip arthroplasty exists. The hypothesis of this study was that the blood loss and transfusion rate is lower in short stems compared to straight stems. METHODS: We compared 124 patients who underwent total hip arthroplasty (THA) using a short-stem design (group 1) and 141 patients using a straight-stem design (group 2). All patients were operated on by the same surgeon, and both groups were similar in age, gender, affected side, body mass index, and ASA score. RESULTS: The calculated blood loss was 1139 ml in group 1 and 1358 ml in group 2 (p < 0.001). The transfusion rate was 8% in group 1 and 15.6% in group 2 (p < 0.001). There was no significant difference between groups 1 and 2 regarding complications and operation time (p > 0.05). CONCLUSION: Compared to patients after straight stem THA, both blood loss and blood transfusion rates were lower in patients after short stem THA.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注短柄与直柄髋关节置换术的失血量和输血率，未涉及任何生物力学、应力遮挡或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical comparison of blood loss and transfusion rates, with no biomechanical modeling, stress shielding analysis, micromotion quantification, or FE validation relevant to hip implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较短柄与直柄髋关节假体在失血量和输血率方面的差异。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性比较124例短柄和141例直柄全髋置换术患者的临床数据。
summary_zh.result: 短柄组失血量（1139 ml）和输血率（8%）均显著低于直柄组。
summary_zh.validation: 基于单外科医生连续病例的临床回顾分析。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether short-stem hip arthroplasty results in lower blood loss and transfusion rates compared to straight-stem designs.
summary_en.method: Retrospective comparison of 124 short-stem and 141 straight-stem THA patients treated by a single surgeon, analyzing calculated blood loss and transfusion requirements.
summary_en.result: Short-stem THA showed significantly lower calculated blood loss (1139 vs 1358 ml, p<0.001) and transfusion rate (8% vs 15.6%, p<0.001).
summary_en.validation: Clinical retrospective cohort study with statistical comparison of surgical outcomes.
